label: Ubiquiti NanoStation M3 (NSM3)
description: airMAX NanoStation M3 2.4 GHz CPE/bridge: 1x 10/100 Ethernet port, passive 24 V PoE in, 802.11n 2x2.
notes: Vendor figures from the NanoStation M datasheet: **(1) 10/100 Ethernet port**, passive PoE 24 V 0.5 A on pairs 4,5+/7,8-, 802.11n 2x2 MIMO. **One port, and it is fast ethernet** - the M3 is a 2.4 GHz CPE whose radio outruns nothing, but the single port matters more: there is no second port to daisy-chain a camera through, which the M5's "Dual Ethernet" models do have. PoE is **passive 24 V, not 802.3af** - plugging it into a standard PoE switch is the classic way to kill one.
